measurements.scope: Isolated native RuntimeComponents; three alternating runs per binary, 100 warm samples per operation. User reported laptop on mains. Builds/tests idle during measurement. Not gameplay, GPU, RPC, C# or cross-device performance.
measurements.tradeoffs: Small writes add approximately 0.4–0.6 microseconds in these samples; preparation adds two vector allocations per sample. Duplicate index costs 16 KiB per store plus retained staging-vector capacity. Ordinary C++ new/new[] counts exclude aligned/direct allocators.
